source_text: Sed quia post editionem illorum oratu tuo, beatissime pater Flore, apud Constantinopolim Manichaei epistula inventa est atque ad has directa partes, opera est aliqua eius inserere, ut intellegant omnes, unde haec pro traduce argumenta descendant.
pass_a_gloss: But because after the edition of those, at your request, most blessed father Florus, a letter of the Manichaean was found at Constantinople and directed to these parts, it is work to insert some of it, that all may understand from where these arguments for the vine-layer descend.

lemmas.lexica: LS tradux=vine-shoot/layer; Blaise tradux peccati=transmission of sin by descent
Blaise Manichaeus; Julian's polemic label vs natural evil

pass_b_english: But since, after those books were published, a letter of Mani was found in Constantinople at your request, most blessed father Florus, and sent to these regions, it is worth inserting some of it. Everyone can then understand where these arguments for inherited sin originate.

choices.why: Julian's standing charge: natural evil is Manichaean. Keep the sect-name, not 'dualists'.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
